title: The Rift of the Three Realms
next_chapter_hook: Within that rift, an eye belonging to no known law slowly opens—and in its depths, Chen Ji sees reflections of spectacles beyond any cognitive limit he has ever known.

text.content: Above the Imperial Capital, black clouds spread like ink, yet they were no ordinary storm clouds. Space itself was twisting, tearing—as if an invisible giant hand had ripped open a gap in the heavens. The aura emanating from the rift's depths made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end—it was neither Spiritual Energy, nor Demonic Energy, nor any force he had ever glimpsed within the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "The First Observer's dying words..." Chen Ji whispered, his pupils contracting. He could sense those words materializing in some incomprehensible way. The countdown of fate seemed truly about to reach zero.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently against his chest, scalding him with intense pain. Chen Ji knew this was no ordinary omen—the Tianji Record only responded to significant events related to itself, and this reaction was a hundred times more intense than any previous vision.

dialogue.content: "It has arrived, faster than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record, his expression grave. "Chen Ji, the rift you see is not a simple spatial tear—this is a channel between dimensions forcibly opened."

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings. The cultivators of the Imperial Capital were still frozen in shock, yet the rift was expanding at a visible rate. At its edges, spatial fragments shattered like glass, revealing behind them a chaotic, indescribable void.

dialogue.content: "Does the legacy left by the First Observer have something to do with this dimensional invasion?" Chen Ji asked gravely, his heart already sensing an ominous foreboding. Upon hearing this, Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking.

"Far more than related." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. "The First Observer spent his entire life searching for methods to counter dimensional invasion. Before his fall, he crystallized his life's work into a safeguard—and that safeguard lies hidden in the deepest part of the Tianji Record."

text.content: At that moment, an intense burning sensation radiated from Chen Ji's chest. Looking down, he saw a golden pattern slowly illuminating on the Tianji Record Fragment, resonating with some long-dormant bloodline within him.

dialogue.content: "This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, a flash of lightning crossing his mind—he suddenly recalled a dream from his childhood that no one had ever mentioned, where he stood before an endless void, and from within that void, a voice called his name.

text.content: "Interesting." Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in his eyes. "So that's how it is. The First Observer chose you for a reason—your bloodline carries factors that connect to the origin of dimensions."

Before Chen Ji could process this shocking information, a low, ancient roar echoed from the depths of the rift. That sound was not a sound wave but directly attacked the soul—Chen Ji felt a splitting headache as the scene before him began to distort.

dialogue.content: "...Mere insects." That voice resounded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, ancient and cold, as if examining an insignificant bug. "Another generation of Observer... Hmph, you are always so overreaching."

text.content: Chen Ji bit down hard on his tongue, using that sharp pain to barely maintain consciousness. Horror filled his heart—could the Eye of Heavenly Way truly be connected to the dimensional invasion? What earth-shattering secret lay hidden within?

choice.prompt: Facing this dimensional invasion beyond comprehension and the oppressive pressure of the Eye of Heavenly Way, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Facing the Higher Dimensions with a Mortal Body
choices.description: Mobilize the power of his bloodline, relying on the mysterious resonance with dimensions to directly clash with this invasion—even with the slimmest chances of victory, never bowing before fate.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline power initially awakens, gaining dimensional resistance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will be significantly consumed, and subsequent foresight abilities will be limited

text.content: Chen Ji tore open his garments violently, and the golden pattern on his chest instantly burst into dazzling light. He could feel some power dormant for ten thousand years awakening within him—the bloodline inheritance he had never known existed.

dialogue.content: "A mere dimension, daring to run wild in the Three Realms?" Chen Ji's voice was like ice, yet golden light swirled in his eyes—his bloodline was battling against the invading force.

choices.text: Relying on the Power of the Observer
choices.description: Activating the legacy of the First Observer dormant within the Tianji Record Fragment, borrowing the wisdom and power of the sages to cope with this crisis—victory through strategy, leveraging force against force.
choices.visible_reward: Unseal the memory of the first Observer
choices.risk_hint: Heritage activation may alert more dimensional beings

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and probed his spiritual sense into the deepest part of the Tianji Record. There, a seal that had been dormant for eons was slowly loosening—the final heritage left by the first Observer.

dialogue.content: "Are you certain?" Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "Once this heritage is activated, there will be no turning back—you will be drawn into a vortex deeper and more terrifying than the conflicts of the Three Realms."

text.content: At that moment, something began to seep through from the edges of the rift, taking shape. They were geometric forms impossible to describe in language—they violated all known physical laws, and the moment the cultivators present gazed upon those figures, they all let out screams of agony.

Chen Ji felt a sharp sting in his eyes, and golden blood trickled from the corners of his eyes—it was the dimensional force directly corroding his soul. Even with his factor connected to the source, he could barely withstand such pure, existence-transcending power.

dialogue.content: "Give up, Observer." That cold voice rang out once more, dripping with condescending mockery. "You think a mere fragmented Tianji Record can oppose the will of dimensions? You ants are nothing but pieces on a chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his eye, yet a cold sneer curled at the corner of his mouth. His greatest skill was finding a way out in desperate situations—the more the Eye of Heavenly Dao tried to crush him, the more he would let them know that even pieces have the power to overturn the chessboard.

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's mockery echoed in the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji had to respond:

choices.description: Counter the Eye of Heavenly Dao's arrogance with Chen Ji's signature sharp tongue, exposing its conspiracy across the Three Realms, letting them know this generation's Observer is no puppet to be manipulated.
choices.visible_reward: Shock all observers present, reputation increased
choices.risk_hint: Provoking higher dimensional beings may invite more fierce attacks

dialogue.content: "Chess pieces?" Chen Ji let out a derisive laugh, his voice cold and sharp as ice. "You've plotted for eons, manipulating every generation of Observers. You must be quite pleased with yourself. But here's the thing—a true chess master never reveals their true face to the pieces—unless, they're also on someone else's chessboard."

choices.description: Not contending with the Transcendent over temporary verbal advantages, memorizing every word, waiting to return the favor with interest—Chen Ji has always excelled at holding grudges without acting rashly.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, accumulate power for later counterattack

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji did not answer. He merely silently recorded this scene in his heart. That faint, fleeting smile at the corner of his mouth was more chilling than any words—because when he smiled like that, it usually meant someone was about to have bad luck.)

text.content: At that moment, a brilliant golden light shot up from the depths of the imperial palace in the capital. It was a qi Chen Ji knew all too well—the qi of the first Observer, which resonated with the bloodline within him.

dialogue.content: "The safeguard... has been activated." Mo Xiansheng's voice was rarely tinged with excitement. "The first Observer indeed left a contingency! Chen Ji, that is his cenotaph—for ten thousand years, he has been waiting for this moment!"

text.content: Within the golden light, a illusory figure slowly formed. It was an elderly man with a blurred face, surrounded by fragments of countless heavenly laws, as if the embodiment of the laws of the Three Realms. His gaze pierced through eons, falling directly upon Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "Junior..." The phantom spoke, its voice aged and gentle, "You've finally arrived. The dimensional invasion is no coincidence—it is the final move 'it' has set upon the Three Realms. And the safeguard I left behind is precisely so that when you need it most, I can reveal a fragment of the truth to you."

text.content: "A great shock reverberated in Chen Ji's heart. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, dimensional invasion, the legacy of the First Observer... All of this seemed to point toward some ultimate truth he had yet to touch. And that phantom had already raised its hand, pointing toward the Tianji Record at his chest."

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record... is not some prophetic divine artifact." The phantom's voice carried infinite vicissitudes, "It is a fragment of the dimensional barrier shattered during the dimensional war—and the blood flowing within you belongs to the Guardian Clan that once protected this barrier."

text.content: "These words were like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He finally understood why the Tianji Record had chosen him, why his bloodline would resonate with dimensions—He was not accidentally becoming an observer, but rather his bloodline was inherently inscribed with the destiny to oppose dimensions."

choice.prompt: "Facing this reality that could overturn all understanding, Chen Ji had to make a choice:"

choices.description: "Since we've touched upon the core truth, we must ask everything clearly—What was the Dimensional War? What is the relationship between the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the dimensional invasion? And why did the Guardian Clan perish?"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain Key Information to Provide Basis for Future Schemes"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may far exceed imagination, bringing greater psychological burden"

dialogue.content: "Why did the Guardian Clan perish? What exactly is the relationship between the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the dimensional invasion?" Chen Ji spoke word by word, his gaze sharp as a blade, "Since you left this safeguard, you must have prepared the answers—Please enlighten me, senior!"

choices.description: "The truth can be pursued later. The priority is solving the current dimensional invasion—first withstand this wave of attacks, then plan for the future."
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Strength, Effectively Respond to Current Crisis"
choices.risk_hint: "Later May Fall into Passive Due to Insufficient Information"

dialogue.content: "It's not too late to pursue the truth later." Chen Ji's gaze turned to the crack still expanding, "Since you've left this safeguard, do you have a method to counter this dimensional invasion? First withstand the threat before us, and this junior will go find the remaining answers!"

text.content: "The phantom nodded slightly, a glimmer of approval flickering in its eyes. "Good, neither arrogant nor impatient—this is the temperament a Guardian descendant should possess." It waved its hand, and a streak of golden light sank into Chen Ji's brow center, "This is my final gift—fragmented memories of the dimensional barrier, enough to give you a few more chances of victory in the battles to come."

"However, the phantom's expression suddenly turned grave in the next moment. "But there is one thing you must be wary of—" Its voice dropped low, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not a mere enemy. It is the twisted product of the first will born when the dimensional barrier shattered. In other words, it is both a traitor to the Three Realms and an outcast from the dimensions."

dialogue.content: "Enough!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice exploded with irresistible fury, "A mere remnant dare speak such presumptuous words here!" A terrifying force surged from the depths of the crack, rushing directly toward the phantom."

text.content: "The phantom's form began to tremble violently, yet it still forced out its last fragment of strength, shouting loudly: "Chen Ji! Remember, what the Eye of Heavenly Dao wants is—" Before the words could finish, the phantom was utterly dispersed by the dimensional force, leaving only a sentence echoing in Chen Ji's Mental Sea."

"Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, nails digging deep into his palms. Just one step, just that final step—what does the Eye of Heavenly Dao want? What was the First Observer trying to tell him? The answers to all this, with the phantom's dissipation, once again sank into the endless mist."

dialogue.content: "Hahaha!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's laughter echoed in the Mental Sea, "The First Observer, so what? Ten thousand years ago he couldn't stop me, and now what can a mere whelp like you change ten thousand years later?"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his head, wiping the blood from the corner of his eye, and a familiar cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. That smile held no anger, no fear—only a chilling calm that made one's spine crawl—the expression he habitually wore when orchestrating schemes across the world."

dialogue.content: "Change what?" Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, "You've been scheming for eons, treating us as mere pieces—what confidence you must have in your chess skills. But have you ever considered, master—what a chess player fears most is never losing a single game, but not knowing what game the opponent is truly playing."

text.content: He paused, his gaze piercing through the狰狞 crack, as if staring at the indescribable existence beyond it. "The predecessor's last words, I've recorded them. The Dimensional War, the Guardian Race, your true purpose—I will uncover them one by one." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried unwavering certainty. "When that time comes, we'll settle this account properly."

"After saying this, he no longer paid attention to the crack, turning and walking away. Behind him, the roars of Dimensional Beings shook the heavens, the fissure continued to expand—but Chen Ji knew today's confrontation had only just begun. The Heavenly Eye wanted him to fear, to despair, but he would make it understand that this generation's Observer was no lamb to be slaughtered."

dialogue.content: "What do you plan to do?" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "The Dimensional Invasion has already begun, the Heavenly Eye's layout is accelerating—we don't have much time left."

Chen Ji raised his head toward that still sky-tearing fissure, golden light flowing in his eyes, yet gradually returning to calm. He didn't answer Mo Xiansheng's question, merely lowering his gaze to glance at the slightly scalding Tianji Record Fragment on his chest, a meaningful smile curling at his lips.

text.content: Dimensional Barrier fragments, the Guardian Race's bloodline, the First Observer's legacy—all clues pointed in the same direction. Chen Ji took a deep breath, silently sketching a brand-new chessboard in his mind. The Heavenly Eye thought itself the Chess Player, yet it didn't know the true game had just begun. And Chen Ji had already seen the direction of the next move.

Just then, deep within that fissure, an eye slowly opened—not the lofty scrutiny of the Heavenly Eye, but an existence far more ancient and terrifying. It held none of the Heavenly Eye's arrogance, only pure, cold curiosity, as if examining prey that had finally grown mature.

The blood throughout Chen Ji's body seemed to freeze in an instant. Deep within that eye's pupil was reflected a form surpassing his cognitive limits—not any shape describable by words, but pure concept, pure law, pure Dimension itself. A thought rang in his mind: This was not the master of the Heavenly Eye, but the true native of the Dimension.

dialogue.content: (The Heavenly Eye's voice rang in the Mental Sea, yet it was rare to hear a tremor within) "Foolish Observer... Do you think you're opposing whom? That is an existence beyond my control—the Dimension itself has set its sights on the Three Realms!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Heavenly Eye... actually could feel fear? That existence that had plotted for eons, playing the Three Realms in its palm, its voice now carried a tremor? Dimension itself—these four words carried weight beyond his imagination a thousandfold. In this moment, Chen Ji finally realized that the enemy he faced was far more terrifying than any he had ever encountered before.
